text: IntegratedLearner provides integrated machine learning framework 1) consolidate predictions borrowing information across several longitudinal cross-sectional omics data layers, 2) decipher mechanistic role individual omics features can potentially lead new sets testable hypotheses, 3) quantify uncertainty integration process. Two integration paradigms supported: early late. Within Bioconductor workflow, intended pattern : assemble aligned assays MultiAssayExperiment, inspect object experiments(), assay(), colData(), sampleMap(), fit IntegratedLearner(), pass predictions, layer weights, feature summaries downstream interpretation visualization steps. IntegratedLearner focuses supervised multi-omics prediction/integration rather general container management unsupervised integration. binary/continuous outcomes, late fusion proceeds 1) fitting machine learning algorithm (base_learner) per layer 2) combining layer-wise cross-validated predictions using meta model (meta_learner). common default BART base learner (base_learner = "sl_bart") sl_nnls_auc meta-learner. multiclass outcomes (family = binomial() two outcome classes), IntegratedLearner dispatches native multiclass backend performs multiclass probability modeling layer, stacked, concatenated levels. Optional filtering screening supported via filter_method/filter_pct run_screening/screen_pct. Multiclass fits also return two late-fusion methods default, independently run_stacked: majority counts layer’s predicted class, weighted_average combines class probabilities using nonnegative layer weights sum one. Weights minimize multiclass log loss --fold layer predictions; training outputs fit weights separately outside held-fold. Set run_majority = FALSE run_weighted = FALSE disable either method. Majority ties use first class fit$class_levels. prob.*$majority matrices contain vote fractions, calibrated probabilities, log loss interpreted accordingly. Fully nested evaluation untouched validation set needed assess complete learned fusion pipeline. survival outcomes, IntegratedLearner dispatches native survival engine (ILsurv) configurable late-fusion weighting (COX/IBS). Supported survival learners include Cox, penalized Cox, tree ensembles, boosting, XGBoost-based survival variants (see full list ). Naming conventions: Use IntegratedLearner’s snake_case sl_* wrappers documented defaults package-provided learners, sl_bart, sl_lasso, sl_nnls_auc. Standard SuperLearner learners remain available upstream names (SL.randomForest, SL.glmnet). Multiclass learners use native IDs without either prefix, randomforest, ranger, xgboost, glmnet, mbart, multinom. Feature workflow (enabled): Filtering happens first (filter_method, filter_pct) training feature table. Screening happens second (run_screening = TRUE, screen_pct) within CV folds final model fit.

Print fitted object print(fit) see summary. MAE_train / MAE_valid: primary MultiAssayExperiment inputs training optional validation. PCL_train / PCL_valid: legacy list inputs (feature_table, sample_metadata, feature_metadata) retained backward compatibility. experiment: Selected MAE experiment names/indices (optional; defaults MAE_train). assay.type: Assay name per selected MAE experiment. outcome_col: Outcome column name sample_metadata / colData. Default "Y". subject_id_col: Subject identifier column name sample_metadata / colData. Default "subjectID". na.rm: Logical; drop features containing missing values extraction/prep. folds: Integer. Number folds cross-validation. Default 5. base_learner: Binary/continuous uses IntegratedLearner sl_* wrappers default (standard SuperLearner SL.* learners also supported); multiclass uses native multiclass learners; survival uses supported surv.* learners. used run_intermediate = TRUE. base_screener: Deprecated. Kept backward compatibility. filter_method: Optional feature filtering method ("prevalence" "variance"). filter_pct: Optional retention percentage (0,100] filtering. run_screening: Logical flag enable supervised screening (FALSE default). screen_pct: Retention percentage (0,100] screening. prevalence_pct: Deprecated alias filter_pct filter_method = "prevalence". meta_learner: Meta learner non-survival late fusion. Defaults "sl_nnls_auc" binary/continuous; multiclass supports native learners (example glmnet, randomforest, xgboost). used run_intermediate = TRUE. run_majority, run_weighted: Multiclass-flags, TRUE default. Return majority voting learned probability averaging independently run_stacked. run_concat: Logical; include early-fusion (concatenated) model non-survival. run_stacked: Logical; include late-fusion stacked model non-survival. run_intermediate: Logical; run standalone direct cooperative learning via multiview package. Default FALSE. TRUE, early fusion, late fusion, single-layer base learners, supervised screening skipped. cooperative_rho: Non-negative agreement-penalty values evaluate cooperative learning. Default c(0, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1). cooperative_s: Penalty value used cooperative predictions. Default "lambda.min". cooperative_type_measure: Optional multiview CV loss/score. NULL, IL uses outcome-appropriate default. drop_poor_performing_layers: TRUE, layers poor single-layer performance removed early late fusion (AUC < 0.5 binary, R2 < 0.5 continuous, C-index < 0.5 survival). Single-layer outputs still retained. Ignored run_intermediate = TRUE. family: gaussian() (continuous), binomial() (binary multiclass), survival family/metadata. ...: Additional backend parameters. survival, includes options do_early_fusion learner-specific hyperparameters (model_args). Automatic outcome coercion: gaussian(): outcome coerced numeric (errors conversion fails). binary binomial(): two classes mapped internally {0,1}. multiclass binomial(): class labels retained. Supported model families: Binary/continuous non-survival: IntegratedLearner sl_* wrappers (available standard SuperLearner SL.* model). Multiclass non-survival: glmnet, randomforest, ranger, xgboost, mbart, multinom. Survival: surv.coxph, surv.glmnet, surv.ranger, surv.ranger.extratrees, surv.ranger.maxstat, surv.ranger.C, surv.rfsrc, surv.coxboost, surv.gbm, surv.xgboost.cox, surv.xgboost.aft, surv.mboost, surv.bart. Direct cooperative learning: standalone multiview feature-level fusion continuous, binary, survival outcomes. Multiclass cooperative learning supported. Supported fusion modules: Continuous/Binary: either standard IL mode single-layer + early (run_concat) + late (run_stacked), standalone cooperative mode (run_intermediate). Multiclass: single-layer + early (run_concat) + late (run_stacked). run_intermediate ignored message. Survival: either standard IL mode single-layer + early (do_early_fusion) + late weighted fusion COX IBS, standalone cooperative mode (run_intermediate).
